en: A black-and-white photograph of a narrow cobblestone street lined with old plastered buildings. The most prominent building has a baroque-style bay window with small-paned glass and ornate tracery, topped by an onion dome and pointed spire. The roofs are covered with small tiles, and the street curves gently downhill between high walls and older townhouses. Leafless trees suggest late autumn or early spring. The overall look is of a quiet historic European town. No visible printed or handwritten text appears on the image side.
